Ch131 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 131)

Subject: mechanism design | ID: 4559

Statement

If X is a homogeneous space and T: X -> X is a reversible operator, then T admits a unique decomposition T = D + N where D is diagonalizable and N is nilpotent.

Proof

Step 1. By compactness of the unitary spectral family \(T_{01310011}\), the image is precompact in the schematic space topology.

Step 2. By the Markovian spectral theorem, we decompose \(U_{01310012} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the Markovian spectral family.

Step 3. By the smooth spectral theorem, we decompose \(Q_{01310013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the smooth spectral family.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the rational convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01310011 \cdot C_01310012 \cdot C_01310013\).
